messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert triggered for service=redwood-inference: inference-hosted-prod
Details: route=/v1/generate, metric=p99_latency, observed=2.6s, threshold=2.0s, SLO-burn=18% (5m) :rotating_light:
pagerduty: Page fired -> oncall-east (alex). Escalation level 1. https://pagerduty.example/incident/RI-21765
alex: Acked. I'm on call. Jumping in now, pinging @mira and @jon.
mira: On it. Pulling traces and hotkeys. Any known deploys in last 30m?
jon: No deploys. Checking telemetry — p95 ~420ms, p99 ~2.6s. Error rates normal. Spike aligns with a traffic bump from client=ChatFlow (qps x3 for the last 7m).
sam: If it's traffic related, can we route ChatFlow to a lower-cost/latency variant temporarily? I can flip a fallback.
carla: Initiating fallback route for that API key. Command: ```rdwctl route update --route /v1/generate --filter "api_key=chatflow-*" --variant gpt-small-q8 --priority 100```
carla: Executed. Will monitor.
alex: Also scaling inference pool to reduce queueing: ```kubectl scale deploy/inference-pool -n prod --replicas=14``` (scaling up from 8)
mira: I see KV cache eviction rates spiking around the same window — could be thrash causing long tail. Flushing prefix cache for chatflow to stabilize working set: ```cachectl flush --prefix "chatflow-" --env prod```
jon: Watching metrics after changes. p99 dropped to ~1.3s within 60s of fallback + cache flush. SLO-burn down to 4% (5m). Nice. :thumbsup:
sre-bot: Autoscaler report: recent scaling events saturated GPU mem on older nodes; recommending gradual scale rather than instant burst.
sam: We should also throttle ChatFlow to their agreed rate temporarily. Suggest soft-limit: `ratelimitctl set --key chatflow-* --qps 150`
carla: Applied soft limit. ChatFlow support contact notified: support@chatflow.example — they acknowledged.
alex: Good mitigation. I'm going to keep the page open for 15m to ensure stability, then handoff.
mira: I'll own the follow-up and postmortem. Initial action items: 1) investigate KV cache eviction root cause (hot prefixes), 2) evaluate autoscaler config for burst handling, 3) add per-customer soft-limits and runbook.
jon: Also recommend reducing default max_batch_size for hosted-prod for this route from 16 -> 8 to reduce latency tail for bursty traffic. Config snippet: ```serviceConfig.routes["/v1/generate"].max_batch_size = 8```
alex: Noted. I'll open a ticket for config change + rollout window.
pagerduty: Acknowledgement recorded (alex). No further escalations.
incident-bot: Incident status: mitigation in place, SLO-burn under control. Monitoring for 20m before close.
carla: Quick note: while fallback helped latency, it increases token cost ~1.4x. We informed billing ops.
mira: Handing off to me for post-incident analysis. I'll collect evals against gold prompt set to ensure output quality didn't regress with gpt-small-q8.
alex: Thanks team. I'll update the customer-facing thread after root cause confirmed. Closing page in 20m if stable. :white_check_mark:
jon: +1. I'll add graphs and trace links to the postmortem.
carla: Adding notes to #incidents and creating postmortem draft in Confluence: https://confluence.example/redwood/incident/RI-21765
(small reactions: :eyes: on some messages, :thumbsup: on mitigation messages)
